_comment: EXAMPLE · PostgreSQL CDC (@stream_publisher) — the configuration choices that decide what a change stream hands you. Registering a stream publisher STARTS it, so there are NO TRIGGERS and none are needed; there is no ctx; and there is one ARRAY slot per tracked table, folded with concat. THE CURSOR is this connector's replication slot. THE ROW SHAPE comes from columns_format and flatten_columns together — metadata always under @td.cdc.meta.* (op i/u/d, tx, sq, ts, ord, sch) and the values as inlined columns, @td.cdc.data.col.new/old.<field>, @td.cdc.data.row.* structs or @td.cdc.data.map.* maps; use columns+flattened for tables you query, struct/map when the tracked schema may change mid-stream. start_from picks where to begin (tail / head / an exact position). src_cfg buffer/trigger/poll thresholds decide WHEN a batch closes. Four stream publishers, one collection each, over a postgrescdc domain seeded with the employees model. Drive it with `tdd domain modify-data --entity employees --ops Mix --sets 5` (--ops takes ONE of Insert/Update/Delete/Mix, not a list). One function per file under functions/postgrescdc_stream/. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite examples/postgrescdc_stream --keep`.
